data_status: preliminary - pure explorer, no annual report; company created July 2026

mines.mine: Puruni Project (Tiger Creek, Peters Mine, Property B)
mines.mine_notes: 100% early-stage gold exploration project in the Puruni region, Guyana, acquired from G2 Goldfields Inc. via the plan of arrangement (completed July 29, 2026) that saw G Mining Ventures Corp. acquire G2. No NI 43-101 mineral resources or reserves disclosed; pure exploration. No production, no revenue. The Arrangement funded G3 with C$45 million in cash plus a contingent value right for potential payments up to US$200 million tied to establishment of M&I mineral resources on the properties GMIN acquired.

notes: G3 Goldfields Inc. exists but is unlisted: it was created as a spin-out from G2 Goldfields Inc. (TSX:GTWO) under a plan of arrangement involving G Mining Ventures Corp., approved by G2 shareholders June 16, 2026 and completed July 29, 2026 (G2 shareholders received 0.5 G3 share per G2 share). G3 is a pure-play Guyana gold exploration company led by CEO Daniel Noone (with J. Patrick Sheridan as a control person). It has applied for listing on the CSE under the symbol 'GTRE' but the listing is still pending. Since it is a private, unlisted, exploration-stage company with no annual report, no resources and no production, no quantitative extraction was possible; the entry above carries the known corporate and asset facts from the July 29, 2026 GlobeNewswire completion release.
